text:
olivia: FYI we just had a customer hit a retry storm from the quickstart curl snippet.
drew: what snippet?
olivia: quickstart README shows: 
```
curl -X POST \ 
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \ 
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY \" \ 
  -d '{\"input\":\"test\"}' \ 
  --retry 4
```
kai: trailing space after the env var and `--retry` on POST = recipe for duplicates + 401 loops.
docs-bot: detected known pattern: trailing-space in Authorization header. Recommend: remove trailing space and add Idempotency-Key example.
drew: agree. two small changes: (1) remove trailing space; (2) replace POST quickstart with a GET for first-run, or if keeping POST add an explicit Idempotency-Key example and a Windows PowerShell variant.
olivia: i'll open a micro-PR to adjust examples and add a short "Retries & idempotency" callout across language quickstarts.
eng-runtime: note: server currently treats token exact-match including trailing spaces. We can consider a forgiving trim but it's intentional to avoid masking misconfig. Raising for discussion.
support: customer confirmed workaround: removing the space fixed auth. Thanks.
docs-bot: issue created: #5011 "quickstart: curl idempotency + auth trailing-space". PR template suggested.
drew: thanks—please also coordinate a tiny SDK parity ticket so Node/Python examples match retry guidance.
olivia: will do and include a short changelog entry. Closing after PR merges.
